card.title: PANZER III-J
card.flavorText: The Panzerkampfwagen III-J was a Panzer III variant, a German medium tank produced from 1939 to 1943. It was manufactured by Daimler-Benz and was used in all major theaters by the Germans and the Axis powers. The Panzer III-J had a main armament of a 1x 5 cm KwK 38/39 gun and a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader, driver, radio operator/bow machine-gunner).
